prompt: [urgently] Something very large is coming through. Send everything we have.
[excited] The shield is down! Its fabrication hangars are open. Destroy the hangars and cut the conduits before it rebuilds them.
[concerned] Commander, that red signal is back. It's coming from inside our space now.
[quietly] It repeats one word. Continuity.
[quietly] The signal has gone quiet, Commander.
[softly] For the first time since it started.
[determined] Destroying their fleets buys us time. Destroying the Arks wins the war.
[concerned] Commander, the commander we destroyed yesterday is back. Same signature, new hull.
[thoughtful] Its mind went somewhere when it died. The relays carry it to an Ark.
[relieved] An Ark is gone, Commander.
[grave] Its commanders have nowhere left to go.
[thoughtful] It wasn't trying to win, Commander. It was trying to get out.
[urgently] Commander, every relay still standing just fired at once, at the same point.
[hushed] Something very large is coming through.
[relieved] The Prime Ark is gone, Commander.
[thoughtful] Whatever it was sending, it was sending it a long way.
[grave] Unknown recipient, Commander. Something was listening.
[concerned] Commander, one last transmission came off the Ark as it broke up.
[hushed] It wasn't addressed to any machine we know.
[quietly] The signal ends there, Commander.
[grave] But it ended with Omega's name.
